name: splicewire/laravel-beam-sync
description: Generic sync foundation: the Syncable contract, the byte-stable SyncData transit base, a tenancy-blind dependency resolver (scope-expand + Kahn topo-sort), and the SyncSource/SyncTarget ports. Copies a dependency cone BY VALUE across shared-nothing boundaries — usable off a local tenant context AND from remote sources. NOT built on stancl/tenancy's resource-syncing (a different, single-row-mirror mechanism); requires no beam, tenancy, or tower.

suggest.splicewire/laravel-beam: Ride the Particle read/write/hydrate pipeline for sync-in/sync-out (the beam-sync-beam bridge).

package-topology.because: beam-sync is a foundation both a beam package (taxonomy) and the tenancy target depend DOWN on; it must never reach UP into either.

noRequire.because: sync is useful without beam and from remote sources; the base never requires beam (the Particle bridge is a separate optional package)
sync is useful without tenancy; the base never requires tower/tenancy
the foundation never reaches up into the consumer-app tier
tower Sync is independent of stancl's resource-syncing (single-row mirror); beam-sync must not inherit that mechanism
